finding: ZH4 pass-7 — DipCoin / Bluefin Pro / Suigar (Sui)
mode: read-only mainnet (GraphQL https://graphql.mainnet.sui.io/graphql); no signing/sending; no secrets in file
primitive_tested: version/package import (old Sui package still callable)

version_gate.mechanism: protocol::check_version(&ProtocolConfig) compares ProtocolConfig.version to a HARDCODED u64 constant; called via protocol::check_basic by value-moving entry fns
version_gate.conclusion: v1..v7 value-moving fns abort with invalid_protocol_version against live ProtocolConfig (version==6); only v8/v9 pass

dipcoin.deprecation_pattern: v9 replaces every superseded entry point body with `LdU64(999); Abort`; real logic lives in _v2/_v3/_v4 variants that call protocol::check_basic
ungated_real_value_movers: vault::update_share_price_v2 (public, ungated; validates NAV.bank_balance == real bank balance; requires a VaultNAV that can only be built by gated new_vault_nav)
price_feed::update_price_feed (public, ungated, but recovers signer and requires == feeder)
roles::set_exchange_admin (entry; takes ExchangeAdminCap BY VALUE => privileged)

verdict.why: version gate (protocol::check_version vs live ProtocolConfig.version==6) blocks every old-version value-moving entry point; the only ungated real value-movers require a VaultNAV that is only produced by the gated new_vault_nav, and update_share_price_v2 re-validates NAV.bank_balance against the live bank

version_gate.mechanism: sweethouse::assert_valid_version(&SweetHouse) requires SweetHouse.version_set.contains(package_version()); package_version() returns a hardcoded constant
version_gate.conclusion: v1's assert_valid_version aborts (0 not in {1}); v2 passes. v1 and v2 bodies are byte-identical for all pool/pipe/sweethouse value functions except the oracle module (refactor) and package_version => no version-differential exploit

share_nav_math.deposit_public_pool: bootstrap if supply==0 OR total==0 -> mint amount+total shares; else mint amount*supply/total
share_nav_math.first_depositor_capture_condition: supply==0 AND total>0 -> depositor of `amount` receives amount+total shares and can redeem total_new=amount+total (profit=total). NOT live: all houses with supply==0 also have total==0
share_nav_math.deposit_capacity_check: amount+total <= max_capacity; USDC/SUI public totals currently EXCEED max_capacity -> deposits blocked

SPRING_SUI_house.note: supply==0 and total==0 -> no live first-depositor capture

verdict.why: version gate blocks v1; v1/v2 value bodies identical so old-version calls are equivalent to latest; no live supply==0&total>0 state for the donation capture

version_gate.mechanism: each entry fn asserts data_store::get_ids_version(ids)==constants::get_version() and get_eds_version(eds)==constants::get_version() (else version_mismatch). constants::get_version() returns hardcoded 1 in EVERY package version.
version_gate.conclusion: NO per-package version gate: every package version v1..v21 passes the check => ALL old versions remain callable on the same shared objects (the version/import primitive IS satisfied).

bluefin_pro.signature_model: entry fns take (payload, signature, intent) and call signature::verify(payload, signature, intent); no tx_context::sender() check exists in the exchange module (1 sender call total, 0 in the value entry points)

AUTHORIZATION_BYPASS_candidate.mechanism: signature::verify_signature_and_recover_signer(message, signature) reads signature[0] as the scheme byte; if scheme==0x05 it returns the ZERO ADDRESS (0x000...000) WITHOUT any cryptographic verification. Callers treat signer==0x0 as authorized.
AUTHORIZATION_BYPASS_candidate.caller_controlled_oracle: these entry fns also call data_store::update_oracle_prices(ids, symbols, prices) with CALLER-SUPPLIED prices; update_oracle_prices performs no bounds check and no signature check
AUTHORIZATION_BYPASS_candidate.profit_path_status: NOT fully established within budget. withdraw_from_bank credits recipient==account (no cross-account redirect). close_position requires a DELISTED market and settles PnL in the payload-specified account => potential insurance-pool extraction but no live delisted market confirmed. adjust_margin/adjust_leverage only re-balance the account's own assets.

bluefin_pro.v17_to_v18_hardening: exchange::withdraw_from_bank gained an explicit account::get_max_withdrawable_amount(..) <= amount check (insufficient_funds) at v18; v17 relies on account::sub_margin_from_asset_vector (bounds by the account's own recorded quantity) + margining_engine::verify_health. Not obviously exploitable as v17 still bounds by the user's balance.

verdict.why: version/import: old versions ARE callable (no per-package gate) but no old-version value function with a weaker guard was proven exploitable; separately a 0x0-signer authorization bypass + caller-supplied oracle prices exist in ALL versions incl. latest, mechanism confirmed but profitable E-U path not completed

blockers: Sui JSON-RPC deprecated; used GraphQL only. simulateTransaction JSON shape not exercised in budget => no dynamic PoC.
Bluefin asset-bank balances live in dynamic fields of a NESTED UID (AssetBank.id) and are not discoverable via GraphQL dynamicFields => exact bank USD not read; corpus value $1.5M used.
Bluefin profitability of the 0x0-signer bypass not fully traced (close_position needs a delisted market; withdraw credits the account owner).
